changelog: WinPreview v1.0.9 - Full High-Quality Image & Cinema Video Engine: Native HEIC/HEIF/AVIF decoding with Display P3 support, Camera RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG) embedded preview extraction, professional cinema video formats (MXF, ProRes, BRAW, R3D, TS), and real-time Log-to-Rec.709 tone-mapping for Apple Log, Sony S-Log3, Canon C-Log3, DJI D-Log M, and Panasonic V-Log footage.
